what: Finger-to-finger gaps of the bench plans along their simulated twists, on the CAD hand's collision spheres (hand-4a, 2026-11-19 21:5x). The lab found at 21:3x that at (70, 90) in the sweep pose "curl 40/40" the thumb's and index's DIP links met: the bench check's three balls per finger (tip pad, tip end, PIP joint) were 27 mm apart there, the cad_v3 scene's collision spheres -0.6 mm, and 4.5 mm at the joints where the MCPs stopped. The ranking's deployable test (index and middle at least 15 mm apart in every simulated run) measured the same three balls.
